answer.reason: The verses tell one deed of Evilmerodach: he freed Jehoiachin from prison and honoured him.

clauses.english: lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah and brought him out of prison
clauses.quote: lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison

doubts: JER 52:34 names the king of Babylon only as giver of the diet; treated as part of the same kindness, not a separate clause.
The two accounts give different days of the month (27th and 25th); no date is stated in the clause.
